title: The Last Lighthouse
description: Narrative storytelling video with warm grade, fade transitions, calm music, and multi-persona dialogue for narrator and character voices.
script:
On the edge of a stormy sea stood the last lighthouse keeper. [Visual: lighthouse stormy sea coast] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
Every night he climbed the spiral stairs to light the lamp. [Visual: spiral staircase lighthouse interior] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
The ships depended on his light to find safe harbor. [Visual: ship ocean night lighthouse beam] [Transition: fade]
One evening a terrible storm cut all power to the island. [Visual: dark storm clouds lightning] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cool]
He lit the lamp by hand, as keepers did a century ago. [Visual: hands lighting lantern flame] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
The ships saw the light and navigated safely to shore. [Visual: ship arriving harbor sunrise] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
Sometimes the oldest ways are still the most reliable. [Visual: keeper looking at sunrise] [Transition: fade] [Kinetic: on]
